## Requirements (spec §5h.2 §3/§9 C0/Stage-1 rows)
1. `MetricDeclaration` — the **single complete form** (CF-094): `{name, dimension, level,
   value_type, direction, unit, requires_observability, applies_to_classes,
   applies_to_families, requires_capabilities, requires_mediation,
   admissible_granularities, detector_classes_allowed, oracle_classes_allowed,
   replicate_reducer, interval_method, outcome_class_policy, headline, veto, charged_to}`;
   applicability = class ∧ observability ∧ capabilities ∧ mediation ∧ family; supersedes the
   three partial forms (`hh-ontology::compliance`, `hh-telemetry::catalogue`,
   `hh-secrets::metrics` interim vocab).
2. `OracleDeclaration{oracle_id, class, deterministic, requires_observability, verdict_type,
   evidence_out, charged_to, calibration_ref?, provenance}` — a `validator`-kind registry
   object; `judge ⇒ ¬deterministic ∧ charged_to = instrument`; `reference_relative ⇒
   three_valued`; headline restriction (C0 admits only the five deterministic classes).
3. `Factor`/`Design`/`Arm`/`PreRegistration` schemas (`Factor` already landed at
   `hh-ontology::config`); `Design{kind, factors, blocking, replicates_per_cell ≥ 1, pairing,
   seed_policy, held_out_split_ref?, pre_registration}`;
   `PreRegistration{registered_at, hypothesis, primary_metrics[], equivalence_margin?, min_n,
   analysis_plan_ref, task_split_hash}`; `Arm{id, hypothesis, design_ref, configurations[],
   eval_budget, search_budget, artifact_ref, provenance}`.
4. Outcome classes: `outcome_class` grows `oracle_failure` (six-class closed sum);
   `derive_outcome_class` from stop-reason + oracle-failure facts; per-metric
   `outcome_class_policy` (capability default `scored ∪ budget_exhausted`, efficiency
   `scored`-only, `refusal_is_failure` opt-in).
5. Typed `n/a{reason}` — the seven-member `NaReason` already landed; `MetricValueKind::Na`
   carries it as a first-class value (never 0, never a proxy).
6. `measurement.metric.emitted` — §5h.2 payload `{metric_ref, value, applies_to, oracle_ref,
   detector, confidence, evidence_ref}` merged with §5h.1 `{subject, metric_ref, value, unit,
   detector_ref}` (WS-B1 extension): one payload builder + strict decoder in `hh-telemetry`.
7. `veto` flag + headline-restriction rule as schema constraints
   (`veto ⇒ ¬headline`; `headline ⇒ oracle_classes_allowed ⊆ C0-headline ∧
   detector_classes_allowed ⊆ {deterministic}`).
8. `eval_budget` equality as a schema constraint on `Arm` — every configuration's budget
   vector equals `eval_budget` (`BudgetMismatchWithinArm`); `search_budget` complete-or-
   unknown (`BudgetMissing` outside product-level); `artifact_ref` sealed (`ArtifactUnsealed`).
9. Registry: `metric_declaration` + `validator` kinds land typed record bodies
   (`has_stage1_schema` += 2; codecs; admission checks).

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-R-2.9.2-2 (deterministic gating subset), AC-R-2.9.2-3 (every registry metric carries the
  full declaration), AC-R-2.9.2-13 (payload/derivation determinism) — the Stage-1 executable
  halves; Stage-3 halves stay deferred.
- Every new behavior has a removal-sensitive test; verification green; requirement ids stamped
  in the PR; ADR(s) for owned decisions; index+ledger advanced.

## Plan
- `hh-ontology::eval` (new module): lowered shared vocabulary — `OracleClass`, `LatticeValue`,
  `VerdictType`, `EvidenceKind` (from `hh-verification::vocab`, re-exported — same pattern as
  `Detector`/`ChargedTo`) and `ChargedTo` (from `hh-hir::kinds`, re-exported); new §5h.2 sums
  (`Dimension`, `MetricLevel`, `MetricValueType`, `Direction`, `ReplicateReducer`,
  `IntervalMethod`, `OutcomePolicy`/`OutcomeClassPolicy`, `MediationChannel`/
  `MediationRequirement`, `DesignKind`, `Pairing`, `SeedPolicy`); records (`MetricValue`/
  `MetricValueKind`, `Design`, `PreRegistration`, `Arm`, `SearchBudget`/`SearchBudgetRecord`,
  `Cell`, `RunOutcome`, `OracleDeclaration`, `EstimatorSelection`); `derive_outcome_class`;
  canonical `to_json`/`from_json` codecs. `hh-ontology` gains `hh-provenance` (acyclic —
  provenance deps on wire only).
- `hh-ontology::compliance::MetricDeclaration` — extended in place to the full form (CC7: one
  declaration type, CF-094's supersession); `applicability` gains capabilities ∧ mediation ∧
  family; `validate` carries the veto/headline/`clt` rules.
- `hh-ontology::control::OutcomeClass` — `+ OracleFailure` (the spec's six-class set).
- `hh-telemetry::events` — `measurement.metric.emitted` extended (WS-B1 members); `catalogue`
  rows carry `dimension`/`direction`/`level`/`veto`/`charged_to` so `declaration()` yields the
  full form (AC-R-2.9.2-3).
- `hh-secrets::metrics` — `SecretMetric` folds into the full form; interim `MetricCharge`/
  `MetricLevel`/`Detector`-as-oracle vocabulary retired (CC7).
- `hh-registry` — `RegistryRecord::MetricDeclaration`/`::Validator` variants, `body_json`/
  `record_from_json` arms, `has_stage1_schema`, `register` admission checks.
- `hh-hir`/`hh-verification` — re-export the moved sums (every existing path preserved).

## Gap table
| # | Gap found at self-review | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Arm::validate` compared `semantic_id`s — two *versions* of the same semantic budget vector would pass while differing dimension-wise (CF-099) | Fixed: `version_id` equality — content-address equality *is* dimension-wise equality at the record layer; consumption-tolerance stays `compare`'s Stage-3 precondition (ADR-0258 D5) |
| 2 | `veto ⇒ ¬headline` not enforced; headline admitted non-deterministic *detectors* unchecked | Fixed: `MetricError.VetoIsHeadline` + `HeadlineAdmitsNonDeterministicDetector` in `MetricDeclaration::validate`, enforced again at registry `register` |
| 3 | `duplicate_effect_count` missing from the catalogue veto set (spec names it a veto, ADR-0047 §5) | Fixed: veto name set now `{audit_completeness, duplicate_effect_count}` |
| 4 | `secret_value_in_ledger`/`_environment` declared wrong `requires_observability` vs spec §5g.3 §4's canonical rows (`{ledger}` / `{end_state}`) | Fixed to the spec rows; oracle classes `trace_predicate`/`end_state` per spec |
| 5 | Stage-3 ops (`compare`, estimators, oracle wiring, `LeakedSplit`) out of scope | DF-S1.22-1 |
| 6 | Stage-3 fault-injection battery out of scope | DF-S1.22-2 |
| 7 | `applies_to_families` = name spellings until `EnvironmentFamily` lands | DF-S1.22-3 (additive migration) |
